title: StateEstimate
description: Estimator output at a UTC instant: named state values (units in the names) and an optional covariance. An estimator that produces no covariance omits it. When present, covariance is a row-major n x n matrix with n = number of state entries, rows/columns ordered as state_order (or, if absent, in the key order of state). Squareness and size are not expressible in JSON Schema and are checked by consumers.

state.description: Map name (with unit suffix, e.g. yaw_deg) to finite number.

state_order.description: Names of state entries giving the row/column order of covariance.

covariance.description: Optional row-major square matrix, n x n for n = number of state entries.
